## Crisis Text Line data sharing

All scores rest on one peer-reviewed editorial [@eysenbach2025]. Texters who
contacted the crisis service had no role in the data activity, so all Domain A
items are ○ and the case is classed as data subjects only. Sharing data with
academic researchers under controlled access had ethics oversight, but consent
was judged inadequate for the commercial use of the same data (B6 = ◐). The
arrangement was discredited and ended under public pressure (C3 and D1 = ○),
which meets two failure criteria; the verdict is failure.
